slashCommands.name: db-er
slashCommands.description: Generate an interactive ER diagram HTML from a database or schema file
slashCommands.step:
Run generate.py to create an ER diagram. Usage: python generate.py --dsn "<connection-string>" --output er.html

Connection string formats:
  MySQL:      mysql://user:pass@host:3306/dbname
  PostgreSQL: postgres://user:pass@host:5432/dbname
  SQL Server: sqlserver://sa:pass@host:1433/dbname
  SQLite:     sqlite:///path/to/file.db

Common options:
  --tables    comma-separated table whitelist
  --exclude   comma-separated table blacklist
  --theme     dark (default) or light
  --output    output HTML path

For offline generation from a JSON schema file:
  python generate.py --schema-file schema.json --output er.html
